# Copilot Instructions for Glimr

A private React + Vite + TypeScript image gallery app with searchable galleries, slideshow, ZIP download, and zoom/pan dialog.

## GLOBAL COPILOT INSTRUCTIONS – NON-NEGOTIABLE PROJECT POLICY

**These rules are absolute and must be followed for every task, commit, or code change. ANY DEVIATION FROM THESE RULES IS CONSIDERED A FAILURE OF TASK EXECUTION.**

### 1. ALL CODE CHANGES GO THROUGH GIT-FLOW

- **EVERY** code change — feature work, bug fix, refactor, dependency bump, config change — **MUST** be performed on a git-flow branch.
- **NEVER** commit code changes directly to `master`, `main`, or `develop`.
- Before making any code change, you **MUST** trigger one of the two workflow skills:
  - **`gitflow-feature`** — for any non-urgent change (new feature, refactor, enhancement, dependency update, docs, tests). This is the default.
  - **`gitflow-hotfix`** — for an urgent production fix that needs to be applied directly on top of `master` and merged back to `develop`.
- If the user asks for a code change without specifying which flow, default to **`gitflow-feature`** and confirm the feature name with the user before starting.
- The skills live in `.github/skills/gitflow-feature/SKILL.md` and `.github/skills/gitflow-hotfix/SKILL.md`. Read the relevant skill before starting any code change.
- **EXCEPTION**: Pure documentation tweaks to files inside `.github/` (instructions, skills) and session-only artifacts may be made directly on the current branch without triggering a flow.

### 2. TASK STARTUP

- **NEVER** begin implementing a task until these copilot-instructions and the relevant skill have been read and understood.
- No matter how small the change, the instructions and the relevant gitflow skill must be reviewed first.

### 3. TESTING REQUIREMENTS

- **EVERY** code change to user-facing behaviour, routing, search, gallery loading, image rendering, or storage adapters **MUST** include or update a Playwright e2e test in `tests/e2e/`.
- The e2e suite is the project's safety net — it is **REQUIRED** to pass before any merge.
- Tests must be **data-agnostic**: load `/manifest.json` at runtime and drive assertions off `manifest.galleries[0]`. Never hardcode gallery slugs.
- **NEVER** leave broken, skipped, or failing tests.

### 4. BUG REPORT REGRESSION TESTING

- When the user reports a bug, you **MUST** write a regression test **BEFORE** attempting a fix.
- The regression test must **FAIL** before the fix and **PASS** after the fix — this proves the fix is correct.
- **NEVER** claim a bug is fixed without a test that specifically targets the reported issue.

### 5. TASK COMPLETION

- A task is **INCOMPLETE** until:
  - `npm run build` succeeds (this also runs `tsc -b` for type-checking).
  - `npm run test:e2e` passes with 0 failures.
  - `npm run lint` reports 0 errors.
- **NEVER** complete a task or finish a branch with a failing build, broken tests, or lint errors.

### 6. GIT COMMIT POLICY

- **NEVER** use `git commit --no-verify` or any flag that bypasses pre-commit hooks.
- **ALWAYS** include the Copilot co-author trailer on every commit:
  ```
  Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
  ```
- **NEVER** force push to `develop`, `master`,.

### 7. DEAD CODE CLEANUP

- **BEFORE** committing, running tests, or running quality gates, identify and **REMOVE** all dead code introduced or exposed by your changes.
- Dead code includes: unused imports, unreferenced types/interfaces, orphaned modules, unused component files.
- If you replace a component, hook, or module, **DELETE** the old file and remove all references.

### 8. NO MIGRATION CODE

- **NEVER** create data migration logic or auto-generation of default galleries when storage is empty. If a user has no galleries in `public/galleries/`, the home page renders empty — that is correct behaviour.

## Project Architecture

- **Framework**: React 19 + React Router 7
- **Build**: Vite 7 + `@vitejs/plugin-react-swc` 3 (these versions are pinned — see `vite.config.ts` for the JSX runtime workaround)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4
- **Virtualisation**: `react-virtuoso` (VirtuosoGrid)
- **Image dialog**: `@radix-ui/react-dialog` + `react-zoom-pan-pinch`
- **Search**: `fuse.js` (per-gallery and global)
- **Downloads**: `jszip` + `file-saver`
- **Gallery preparation**: `scripts/find-duplicates.ps1` (full-content duplicate detection) + `scripts/prepare-galleries.mjs` (probes images with `sharp`, hashes for duplicate verification and cover dedup) — run offline, never on startup
- **Testing**: Playwright (smoke suite in `tests/e2e/`) + Vitest unit tests (`src/**/*.test.ts`, `scripts/**/*.test.mjs`) — no Jest in this project

## Project Structure

```
glimr/
  public/
    galleries/        # User gallery folders (gitignored — images live locally)
    manifest.json     # Catalogue generated by prepare-galleries.mjs (gitignored)
    data/             # galleries/<slug>.json + search-index.json (gitignored)
  data/               # duplicates.json, image-cache.json, prepare-report.json (gitignored)
  scripts/
    find-duplicates.ps1     # Full-content SHA-256 duplicate groups -> data/duplicates.json
    prepare-galleries.mjs   # Probes/hashes images, verifies + merges duplicates, writes catalogue
    check-prepared.mjs      # predev check that prepared data exists and is current
    lib/galleries.mjs       # Pure helpers (unit-tested)
  src/
    components/       # GalleryCard, ImageDialog, FilterBar, etc.
    pages/            # Home, GalleryView, Favorites
    lib/              # manifest.ts (runtime fetch), storage.ts (URL adapter)
  tests/
    e2e/              # Playwright smoke + regression tests
  .github/
    copilot-instructions.md   # This file
    skills/
      gitflow-feature/SKILL.md
      gitflow-hotfix/SKILL.md
  vite.config.ts      # Pinned plugin + define workaround
  playwright.config.ts
```

## Developer Workflows

```bash
npm run galleries:duplicates  # Find byte-identical gallery folders -> data/duplicates.json
npm run galleries:prepare     # Probe/hash images (cached), write catalogue, gallery data, search index
npm run dev          # Vite dev server on http://localhost:5174 (predev only checks prepared data)
npm run build        # tsc -b && vite build (uses already-prepared data)
npm run test         # Vitest unit tests
npm run preview      # Preview production build
npm run lint         # ESLint
npm run test:e2e     # Playwright smoke + regression suite
```

## Manifest Behaviour

- Image probing and hashing are **offline only**. After adding/changing folders in `public/galleries/`, run `npm run galleries:prepare` (optionally `galleries:duplicates` first) and restart `npm run dev`. Never move probing back into dev/build startup.
- `public/manifest.json` (`formatVersion: 2`) is a lightweight catalogue (`slug, title, description, tags, cover, imageCount, aliases`) **runtime-loaded** by `src/lib/manifest.ts`. Image lists live in `public/data/galleries/<slug>.json` (`useGallery`); the global search index `public/data/search-index.json` is loaded only when searching (`useSearchIndex`).
- Duplicate candidates from `data/duplicates.json` are merged only when their full content signatures match; merged folders become `aliases` and `/g/<alias>` redirects to the canonical gallery. Visited state is alias-aware.
- The home page paginates client-side (24 per page, after search and the viewed filter); `page` and `q` are URL params. The Favourites card shows on page 1 for every viewed filter, except while searching.
- `vite.config.ts` excludes `public/galleries` and `public/data` from the dev watcher; watching ~140k images blocks the dev server for over a minute.
- Each gallery may include an optional `meta.json` (`{ slug, title, description, tags, cover, imageTags }`) and an optional `urls.txt` (one URL per line, paired by index to filenames `<paddedIndex>-<safe>.<ext>`).
- Cover selection: SHA-256 hashes every image, then picks the first image whose hash is unique to that gallery (and not yet used as a cover elsewhere). `meta.json.cover` overrides automatic selection.

## Storage Adapter (`src/lib/storage.ts`)

- `thumbUrl(img)`, `viewUrl(img)`, `downloadUrl(img)` are the three URL helpers.
- If `img.sourceUrl` is a `blogger.googleusercontent.com` URL, `thumbUrl` rewrites the path to `/s320/` and `viewUrl` to `/s1600/`. Otherwise both fall back to local `img.src`.
- `downloadUrl` always returns the local `img.src` so ZIPs are bit-perfect.

## CRITICAL — Vite Version Pin

The project **MUST** stay on `vite@^7` + `@vitejs/plugin-react-swc@^3`. Vite 8 + Rolldown's deps optimizer baked the production React runtime into `node_modules/.vite/deps/react_jsx-dev-runtime.js` (resulting in `exports.jsxDEV = void 0`) which breaks dev with `$RefreshReg$ is not defined` or `_jsxDEV is not a function`.

`vite.config.ts` also hardcodes `define: { 'process.env.NODE_ENV': '"development"' }` (both root and `optimizeDeps.esbuildOptions.define`) as a belt-and-braces guard. Do not remove these without re-testing.

## Coding Conventions

- TypeScript strict mode. Never `any` unless interfacing with an external untyped lib.
- Functional components with hooks. No class components.
- Use the existing `useManifest()` hook for any manifest consumer — never re-fetch `/manifest.json` directly.
- Prefer named exports for components and hooks.
- Tailwind utility classes for styling. No CSS-in-JS.
- Tests live in `tests/e2e/*.spec.ts`. Use semantic locators (`getByRole`, `getByText`) over raw selectors where possible.
